verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents a public Editor API at api.playcanvas.com/editor for programmatic scene manipulation, asset management and custom tooling, and the user manual points to changing scenes from code via this API. The npm-published engine runtime adds a scriptable public API, and an official MCP server lets agents drive the Editor. missing for 10: REST API appears only as a plan line item with no documented endpoints, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), no independent hands-on corroboration of driving the Editor API.
